newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA fuel oil bunkers dip as rest of Europe gains.
newsitem.headline: ARA fuel oil bunkers dip as rest of Europe gains.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers dipped on Monday slightly while bunkers in other European ports firmed, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers slipped to $114/$115 fob as one refiner continued to offer barges into the ARA market. The major in question is still operating without its flexi-coker which may take another week to restart.
Suppliers said the weak prices also suited some traders who were pricing in cargoes.
The ARA market experienced reasonably brisk trade with many owners expecting prices to rise within a week.
Hamburg prices were up by around $2 a tonne to $120/$122 fob with poor demand.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers were also up by about $2 a tonne.

Suppliers were mostly resting ahead of the New Year break, but some said there were a few urgent enquiries from owners who wanted delivery by the end of December. Suppliers said they were unable to meet such demands
